idea.title: Daily Spike In Rss Counts For Corporate Layoff Announcements
idea.thesis: Spike in layoff announcements signals worsening labor market conditions and potential consumer demand contraction. Consumer discretionary stocks often underperform amid rising unemployment risks.
data_sources: RSS news feed counts for corporate layoffs
idea.signal_logic: Enter short XLY when daily RSS counts for layoffs rise 35% above 10-day average
idea.entry_exit: Entry: Enter short XLY when daily RSS counts for layoffs rise 35% above 10-day average Exit: Exit after 7 trading days or when counts revert below 10% above average
idea.position_sizing: Allocate 5% per signal, max 20% total exposure.
idea.risks: Data source instability, false positives, and regime shifts.
idea.implementation_notes: Use RSS news feed counts for corporate layoffs via api (daily).
idea.reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Layoff news often clusters around earnings and economic reports, generating multiple spikes yearly.
